title: Volatility
subtitle: Equity indices and commodities: realized vs implied
headline: Wednesday 11 November 2026. VIX 17.5 (mid-range), realized 22.2%, spread -4.7 points, curve in contango. The market charges +4.0 points over the HAR+IV model. Top idea: sell WTI vol at the OVX level.

sections.title: S&P 500 volatility
paragraphs: The VIX closed at 17.5, the 56th percentile of its trailing year (mid-range). The S&P 500 realized 22.2% over the last 21 sessions (100th percentile) and 14.7% over 63. Implied sits 4.7 points below realized: options are cheap against recent history.

Since 2015 the one-month variance premium (implied today minus realized over the next 21 days) averaged +3.5 points and was positive on 83% of days. Today's -4.7 spread is below that average: the seller is paid less than usual going in.

The HAR+IV model, which debiases the VIX with past realized vol, forecasts 13.5% for the next month (pure HAR-RV: 16.7%). The gap between market and model is +4.0 points, in the '2 to 4' bucket. Historically in that bucket the forward premium averaged +2.9 points and was positive 85% of the time.

sections.title: Term structure
paragraphs: Curve: VIX9D 16.0, VIX 17.5, VIX3M 19.2, VIX6M 21.1, VIX1Y 22.2. VIX / VIX3M = 0.909, contango (normal: the market expects vol to mean-revert up). The curve has been inverted on 7% of days since 2015.

The forward vol between 30 and 91 days is 20.0%: that is what the market charges for month two and three, above spot VIX. VVIX at 90 and CBOE SKEW at 149 (72th pct) describe the vol-of-vol and tail pricing.

sections.title: Cross-asset
paragraphs: Among the assets with a CBOE implied index, Gold has the richest options (IV 24.2% vs realized 24.4%, -0.2 points) and Nasdaq 100 the cheapest (-9.0 points). Realized vol percentiles over one year: S&P 500 100th, Nasdaq 100 100th, Russell 2000 99th, Euro Stoxx 50 74th, WTI Crude 66th, Gold 58th, Silver 40th, Natural Gas 63th, Brent Crude 71th, Copper 32th, Aluminium 31th, Wheat 6th, Corn 12th, Soybeans 48th.

sections.title: WTI crude
paragraphs: OVX at 51.3 (42th pct 1y) against 55.9% realized on the front future. The CLZ26 / CLZ27 calendar spread is +15.9%: the curve is in backwardation.
Samuelson effect today: CLZ26 (0.3 months out) realizes 42% against 23% for CLX27 at 11 months. News hits the front of the curve; the back is anchored by marginal cost.
Selling crude vol at the OVX level earned +4.2 points on average in backwardation (positive 74% of days, worst -40.4) versus -0.6 in the other regime.

sections.title: Scheduled events
paragraphs: Next FOMC decision: 2026-12-09 (27 days). It is outside the 9-day window, so VIX9D carries no identifiable event premium today.

Over 95 meetings since 2015 the term structure priced an average 0.68% move and the S&P realized 0.80% (ratio 1.09, realized above implied on 35% of meetings, max ratio 6.3x on 2024-06-12). Event vol is fairly priced; the generic month is not: the carry lives in the days with no scheduled news.

sections.title: Skew (SPY 30d, last snapshot)
paragraphs: Snapshot 2026-11-12: ATM 14.0%, 25-delta put 16.9%, 25-delta call 12.2%, risk reversal -4.68 points, butterfly +0.57. 12 snapshot day(s) in the history so far.

ideas.title: Sell WTI vol at the OVX level
ideas.instrument: USO / CL 1m variance at the OVX (crude ATM vol sits about 5% below OVX)
ideas.thesis: OVX 51.3 against 55.9% realized. In backwardation the crude variance premium averaged +4.2 points, positive 74% of days. Scarcity regimes have paid the seller.

ideas.title: Sell 1-month S&P variance at the VIX
ideas.instrument: 1m variance swap at the VIX, held to expiry (the premium sits in the wings, not at the money)
ideas.thesis: With the curve in contango, the forward premium (VIX today minus realized over the next 21 days) averaged +3.7 points in this bucket and was positive 80% of the time.

ideas.title: Sell the 1-month ATM S&P straddle, delta-hedged daily
ideas.instrument: SPX / SPY 1m ATM straddle at the ATM vol (about 0.8 x VIX), hedged at each close
ideas.condition: VIX - HAR+IV gap in the '2 to 4' bucket (+4.0 pts today)
ideas.thesis: The market charges +4.0 points over the debiased model. In this bucket the straddle kept -0.16% of spot per trade after hedge costs, 56% winners.

stats.unconditional: all 261 trades since 2005: -0.13% avg, 54% hit, worst -9.8% (Sep 2008)

method: Ideas are ranked by historical conditional expectation divided by the historical worst case in the same regime (expected P&L per unit of tail). Conditioning variables: the VIX minus HAR+IV gap bucket, the VIX / VIX3M curve bucket, the WTI Dec/Dec curve regime, the FOMC calendar. Gross of financing, net of hedge costs where stated.
caveats: Free data: Yahoo Finance closes and CBOE indices. Option quotes are delayed; implied vols are rebuilt from mids with Black-76.
Conditional statistics are in-sample averages over overlapping daily windows; treat small buckets as indicative.

The straddle backtest sells at the S&P ATM vol (VXO / sqrt(30/22) to 2021, then VIX x a ratio modelled on VIX and SKEW), with 1 bp hedge cost and 0.5 vol point bid-ask; no margin, no financing. Sold at the VIX it would look far better: VIX prices the skew, an ATM straddle does not get paid for it.
